priorities.summary: Unauthenticated remote takeover of Oracle E-Business Suite Workflow, exploitable over HTTP with no privileges or user interaction. Fixed in Oracle's October 2026 Critical Patch Update; EBS versions 12.2.3 to 12.2.15 are affected.

Improper authentication in Microsoft's AAD App Proxy lets an unauthorized attacker elevate privileges over the network without authentication. One of several CVSS 10.0 flaws disclosed in the October 2026 round of Microsoft advisories.

Unrestricted file upload in the WordPress MapSVG plugin (through 8.16.1) allows an attacker with low privileges to upload a web shell to the server. Site owners should update MapSVG past 8.16.1 immediately.

model.name: Nvidia Flora
model.summary: Nvidia's GEAR lab open-sourced Flora, a trio of models that turn raw robot and human manipulation video into training labels — segmenting actions, captioning them, and scoring outcomes. Nvidia says the suite already labels 200,000 hours of video a day for its GR00T humanoid models at a claimed 125x lower cost than GPT-6 Astra.
